detail: Inflation is still sticky, which could keep pressure on interest rates. This is the backdrop for bond yields hitting multiyear highs, which usually pressures growth stocks like yours.

headline: Bond yields at multiyear highs, stocks hit fresh records
detail: This is the core tension. High yields make borrowing expensive and can make bonds more attractive than stocks. Your tech/chip names are particularly sensitive to this dynamic.
rec: Monitor if this divergence continues. If yields keep climbing, it could eventually break stocks' defiance. Consider tightening stops on leveraged positions if they show weakness.
